build_tvm_backend: build a TVM backend for a PyTorch Dynamo-compiled graph with auto_scheduler tuning
run_tvm_meta_schedule: run the tvm_meta_schedule partial to compile a model with TVM's meta_schedule tuner
test_tvm_auto_scheduler: test the tvm_auto_scheduler partial to build a TVM-optimized module with auto_scheduler
check_tvm_availability: check if TVM is available by calling has_tvm and returning True or False
get_llvm_target: get the optimal LLVM CPU target string based on the machine's CPU capabilities
